title: Strategy and execution
learning_outcomes: Explain diagnosis in the context of strategy and execution.
Compare and distinguish strategic alternatives in the context of strategy and execution.
Apply execution measures in the context of strategy and execution.
Evaluate and justify decisions about adaptation in the context of strategy and execution.

lessons.title: Diagnosis
lessons.outcome: Explain diagnosis in the context of strategy and execution.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving diagnosis; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to strategy brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain diagnosis from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of diagnosis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Strategic alternatives
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish strategic alternatives in the context of strategy and execution.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving strategic alternatives; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to strategy brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain strategic alternatives from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of strategic alternatives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Execution measures
lessons.outcome: Apply execution measures in the context of strategy and execution.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving execution measures; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to strategy brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain execution measures from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of execution measures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Adaptation
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about adaptation in the context of strategy and execution.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving adaptation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to strategy brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain adaptation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of adaptation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of diagnosis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of strategic alternatives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of execution measures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of adaptation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
